title: Document-to-JSON Converter
description: Turn any PDF (invoice, bank statement, contract, or generic document) into clean structured JSON. Paste a public PDF URL and get organized data back. Works with scanned PDFs via OCR.

file_url.title: PDF URL
file_url.description: Public link to your PDF file. Supports Dropbox, Google Drive, or any web server. Max 20MB.

document_type.title: Document type
document_type.description: Type of document to parse. 'generic' is free during launch and extracts text + tables from any PDF.

language.title: OCR language
language.description: Language(s) used for OCR on scanned PDFs. ISO codes joined by '+'. Supported: eng, ita, spa. Default: eng+ita+spa

validate_totals.title: Validate totals
validate_totals.description: Check if line item sums match declared totals. Recommended for invoices.
